The stdout/stderr blobs are committed evidence (gate_tests_stdout.json/gate_tests_stderr.json) bound via the TaskReport receipt. The projection intentionally mirrors the authority trusted-receipt contract. A future gate schema may add stdout binding; not blocking for CR-010.
